company.name: SuperTokens
company.shortDescription: SuperTokens offers an open source authentication - as an alternative to Auth0, Okta, Firebase Auth and AWS Cognito
company.description:
SuperTokens provides open source authentication and authorization for web and mobile apps. This includes login, email verification, 2FA, SSO, secure session management, access control and more.

SuperTokens aim to be the simplest and quickest to implement

productsAndServices.description: An open source authentication system providing session management, user login, and security features for developers to integrate into applications.
productsAndServices.name: SuperTokens Open Source Authentication Core

productsAndServices.description: A multi-factor authentication service that adds additional verification layers like OTPs and TOTP to enhance account security.
productsAndServices.name: SuperTokens Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

productsAndServices.description: A feature enabling user authentication via third-party social providers like GitHub, Google, and Facebook.
productsAndServices.name: SuperTokens Social Login Integration

productsAndServices.description: A system for managing user sessions with features like token refresh, session revocation, and secure cookie handling.
productsAndServices.name: SuperTokens Session Management

productsAndServices.description: An option to deploy the SuperTokens authentication system on a customer’s own infrastructure for greater control and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: SuperTokens Self-Hosting Deployment
